scope: 166 owned legacy public HTML pages, excluding the core agent’s nine pages and seven app/legal/error pages. Closes all 101 previously pending pages owned here; core agent owns the remaining six previously pending pages.

research.observation: Organizes the offer around owner jobs such as call handling, scheduling and office workload; shows a concrete customer interaction and outcome. Used the problem/result structure only, not its claims, statistics or wording.
Connects the initial inquiry to a concrete intake result and makes private rehearsal a confidence-building step. Did not borrow availability, integrations or proof claims.
Uses trade-specific on-the-job context and explains the handoff a contractor receives. Applied concrete task language rather than cost claims or delivery promises.
Comments emphasize incomplete intake, chasing missing details and excessive questions. Used these as hypotheses for concise inquiry/detail/handoff copy, not representative statistics or testimonials.
Discussion distinguishes response speed from a clear next owner and follow-up. Avoided claiming an automated response alone finishes the work.
Voice-of-customer research and explaining why a headline/page structure fits the reader. Used task-specific language and a clear next action; no borrowed copy.

restrictions: No routes, form fields, scripts, styles, legal policies, fees, activation, provider requests, messages, commit, push or deployment changed by this pass. Existing links, controls and SVG markup retained.
